_comment: #1057: merge into a TUI seat's Claude Code settings (project or seat-local), NOT the global ~/.claude/settings.json. The seat must be started with SWARM_PARENT_SID=<parent session id> in its environment (the coordinator's kind=tui start injects it); without it the hook logs SKIPPED and posts nothing. The hook always exits 0. Log: ~/.agenthop/logs/subagent-hook.log (override with AGENTHOP_SUBAGENT_HOOK_LOG).
